questions.title: 原创示例：学习环境
questions.passage: A student group compared two study spaces for one week. One room allowed conversation, while the other required silence. Participants chose their own rooms and recorded how much work they completed. Students in the quiet room reported finishing more tasks. However, the groups may have differed in motivation before the study began. A stronger comparison would assign students to rooms randomly and measure similar tasks in both spaces.

questions.stem: Why would random assignment strengthen the comparison?

options.label: A
options.text: It would guarantee that every student enjoys silence.

options.label: B
options.text: It would eliminate the need to measure completed tasks.

options.label: C
options.text: It could reduce differences between the groups before studying.

options.label: D
options.text: It would allow conversation in both study spaces.

questions.title: 原创示例：修理活动建议
questions.prompt:
Your campus club plans to hold a repair workshop. The organizer, Jordan Lee, asks members for suggestions.
Write an email to Jordan. In your email:
• Suggest one useful repair skill to teach.
• Explain what materials participants should bring.
• Offer one way you could help organize the workshop.
questions.subject: Ideas for the repair workshop

questions.title: 原创示例：共享学习空间
questions.prompt:
Professor: Our class is discussing how a university should use a vacant room. Would a quiet study room or a collaborative project space be more useful to students? Explain your view.
Morgan: A quiet room would help students who cannot find a peaceful place at home.
Riley: A project space would make it easier for students from different courses to work together.
Write a contribution to the discussion. Support your opinion with reasons or examples.
